translation.title: Insect Bites and Itching Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for insect bites, itching and chilblains.
translation.usage: Apply one patch at a time to the affected area once to several times a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine; children under 30 months of age; the eyes or the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas; sensitive skin. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced allergic symptoms from medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin, erosion or inflammation. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only; do not take it by mouth or inhale it. Take care to keep it out of the eyes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water. Do not cover or wrap the application site, and do not expose it to external heat or hot water. If water touches the area where the medicine was applied, you may feel strong irritation. People with particularly delicate skin must not use it continuously on the same area. Each application should last about 4 to 5 hours; do not use it on the same area for a long time. If the affected area is wet with sweat or the like, wipe it dry before use. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness; swelling; itching; pain; swelling. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
